{{Quote|Ah, there's not a feeling in this galaxy like riding a hundred-ton walker right through the middle of a combat zone, huh, kid?|Bex Kolos|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''''Manka''-class armored transport''', also known as an '''APC'''<ref name="Running">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Hit the Ground Running|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and at times as an '''ATV'''<ref name="CM">{{TORcite|exp=strongholds|type=item|Damaged Republic ATV|Underworld Alliance Pack}}</ref>, was a model of [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] in use by both the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]]. Making up part of the Republic's armored vehicle units, the ''Manka''-class armored transport saw use on battlefields across the galaxy, including extensive use across [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], as well as on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Voss]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], throughout the period of conflict between the two galactic powers. It was also present in the city of [[Olaris]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], during the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Manka''-class [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] functioned as a quadrupedal [[Walker/Legends|walker]] with a central body, designed to carry up to 16 infantrymen, and plated in [[Durasteel/Legends|Durasteel armor]] which enabled it to transport ground forces into areas too risky for [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. Connected via a short "neck" was an armored [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], which had the mobility to turn and view targets through its small, reinforced windows, with the addition of scopes, and housed the two primary [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]].<ref name="TOR" />

[[File:Manka-class.png|thumb|250px|Manka-class armored transport]]
Four legs carried the walker over ground, and were protected by additional armor plating. Attached to the legs were its "feet", which were equipped with stabilizing grasping claws. On either side were two ball-mounted twin cannons providing the walker cover on its port and starboard sides. On the back of the hull were two smaller turrets to provide covering fire when deploying or withdrawing ground troops. To give access to its transport compartment, the whole rear hull was deployed, ending with a telescopic ramp.

==Usage==
The Manka-class was not only used as a personnel carrier but at times even used to transport cargo and supplies though dangerous areas. One such instances was on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the Cold War, where the walkers heavy armor protected the crew against the hostile tarisian wildlife and especially the [[Rakghoul]]s.<ref name="AWOL">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|AWOL|Taris}}</ref>
